data.body: Gerrit change 2798 / patchset 1 reached LLM-Review +1 with zero unresolved comments, but Verified run 34160080699 failed only ubuntu-latest py3.13 at tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py::test_rebased_content_equivalent_branch_reports_merged after 20,121 passes (82 skipped). This is the exact already-tracked nondeterministic test-isolation bug buttery-taurine-kinglet (46be-40e8-db3f-4597): its RCA reproduced ambient BASH_ENV leakage causing returncode=0 with empty stdout, and its functional fix is not yet landed. Project policy forbids blind recheck for nondeterministic tests, and this session is constrained to comments/documentation, so change 2798 was marked WIP with the evidence and its patch remains unchanged. Resume submit/close after the isolation fix lands and a fresh Verified run passes.
